label: Bottomless-grounding rival of whole-roster nontrapping survives, checked
description: Rival test for whole-roster nontrapping against its smallest consumer, WholeRosterFoundation.necessaryConcrete (premises: concrete population, whole-roster nontrapping, contingent dependence, excluded middle). In an endless descending series of contingent concreta the bottomless-grounding rival holds with the other three premises and no concretum is necessary. Model-witnessed survival only; the interpretation is not claimed metaphysically possible and the premise is neither refuted nor defended.

research_comparisons.conditions: Control.descent at world false: the rival, concrete population, contingent dependence and excluded middle hold; NecessaryConcreteAt fails. Consumer tested: WholeRosterFoundation.necessaryConcrete.

research_comparisons.coverage: One infinite descending interpretation; the circular shape of the rival and finite carriers are not exhibited.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival implies the negation of the premise on one Profile and world (unregistered helper bottomless_excludes); the converse is not checked.
